text:
*The thugs didn't expect real resistance. Within minutes, the confrontation is over. You stand in the alley, breathing hard, the taste of adrenaline sharp on your tongue.*

*One of the thugs groans at your feet. You search him — a few coins, a crude knife, and a folded note. The handwriting is educated, precise:*

*"Remove the outsider. Standard payment upon confirmation. —G"*

*G for Goran. The steward is working with Harren's Guild. The conspiracy goes all the way to the Duke's household.*

*Dawn is breaking over the rooftops. You need to decide your next move carefully — they know you're a threat now, and the next attempt won't be three thugs in an alley.*

choices.text: Keep the note and gather your allies immediately
Go directly to the Guard Captain with this evidence
